tools.name: get_proxy_prices

tools.name: quote_proxy_price
tools.description: The exact price of one AeonProxy purchase: residential or mobile traffic in GB (1–1000; the tier rate applies to the whole amount) or a number of ISP / datacenter IPs for a rental term. tools.name: get_ip_stock
tools.description: Countries where AeonProxy ISP (static residential) or datacenter IPs can be ordered right now, with the number of IPs in stock (the figure the dashboard's order form shows; it changes during the day) and the price per IP for each rental term. One order is 1–100 IPs of one country.

tools.name: check_site_access
tools.description: Whether the AeonProxy gateway blocks a site or port by default for residential and mobile traffic: mail ports, .gov / .mil sites and listed banking, payment and ticketing sites; and whether the signed-in account has the site blocks lifted. tools.name: get_service_status
tools.description: Live state of AeonProxy from the monitor behind https://aeonproxy.com/status: the gateway (HTTP and SOCKS5), the residential and mobile networks, the dashboard and the API, checked every 10 minutes, with the incidents of the last 7 days.

tools.name: test_proxies
tools.description: Tests proxy lines from any provider with one request each (the AeonProxy proxy tester): whether the proxy answers, the HTTP status, latency, the exit IP and its country; SOCKS5 lines also get a UDP check. Accepts host:port:user:pass, user:pass@host:port or scheme://user:pass@host:port. Up to 10 line

tools.name: search_aeonproxy_docs
tools.description: Searches the AeonProxy website and documentation (setup guides for antidetect browsers, browsers, phones, scraping tools and code; how sessions, targeting, protocols, limits and gateway errors work; the REST API; FAQ) and returns the best matching sections with their links. The documentation is in E

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: The signed-in AeonProxy account: balance, residential and mobile traffic bought, used and left, number of sub-users and active orders, the gateway address and ports, and the main proxy login of each product (the password is not shown here; generate_proxy_lines returns complete lines).

tools.name: generate_proxy_lines
tools.description: Ready-to-use residential or mobile proxy lines for the signed-in AeonProxy account, with the proxy login and password in them: country, region, city and ISP (residential) or carrier (mobile) targeting, rotating (a new IP for every connection) or sticky sessions of 1 minute to 6 hours, HTTP or SOCKS5

tools.name: fetch_via_proxy
tools.description: Fetches a web page through the signed-in account's AeonProxy residential (default) or mobile proxy from the chosen country, region or city, and returns the HTTP status, the final URL and the content as Markdown (default), plain text or HTML. tools.name: get_traffic_usage
tools.description: The signed-in AeonProxy account's residential or mobile traffic per day over the last 1–30 days (GB, requests, success rate, requests refused because the site is blocked by default; sub-users included), and the GB left now. Days are UTC.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: The signed-in AeonProxy account's orders, newest first: traffic purchases, trial and bonus traffic, ISP and datacenter IP rentals and unlimited plans, with status, GB left, number of IPs, expiry and next renewal. get_order returns the IPs and logins of one order.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: One of the signed-in AeonProxy account's orders by its number. For ISP and datacenter orders it lists every IP with its host, HTTP and SOCKS5 ports, login and password, plus ready host:port:user:pass lines.
